target_customer: Health minded grocery shoppers buying dairy free cream cheese and egg alternatives, sold through retailers such as Whole Foods and Sprouts
problem: Plant based dairy and egg products were low in protein and nutrition and expensive, and Spero set out to make them from cheaper, nutrient dense seeds.
business_model: Consumer packaged goods sold wholesale to grocery retailers
product_category: Plant based dairy and egg alternatives (sunflower cream cheese, pepita egg)

founders.name: Phaedra Randolph
founders.background_notes: YC page lists her as Founder and Founding CEO. Background not stated in the sources opened.

exit.reason: Reported by a company database as an all cash asset purchase that made Spero an operating subsidiary of Superlatus. No shutdown explanation found.

competitors.name: JUST Egg (Eat Just)
competitors.traction_then: Described in May 2019 as one of Spero's major competitors

technical_complexity.rationale: Food processing at scale with novel seed based formulations and 21 patent applications claimed by the company on its YC page.

defensibility.rationale: Patent applications were filed but pending, and plant based dairy was a crowded category with large funded rivals.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Well funded plant based brands existed in the category, but no source shows a rival copying Spero specifically. Spero was bought by Superlatus in 2023 per a database.

market_need_then: Plant based dairy and egg demand was growing in 2018 and 2019, and the founder cited low nutrition and high price in existing products.

branding.domain_note: Company site was sperofoods.co per a search result; no acquisition detail found.

identity.visual_style: Packaging and web work won Hermes Creative Awards in 2021
identity.voice_and_tone: Mission led: healthy food as a human right, with whole food ingredients, affordability and taste as three pillars.

branding.brand_signature: Sunflower Cream Cheese made from sunflower seeds

brand_strength.rationale: Reached national grocery retail and won four 2021 Hermes Creative Awards, two gold, but no evidence of a strong community or viral brand.

outcome_analysis: Spero launched sunflower cream cheese into national grocery chains and announced a pepita egg, and raised money after YC according to databases. It was reported acquired by Superlatus in October 2023 through an asset purchase, while YC lists it inactive. No source gives the reason for the end of the standalone company, so the cause is not public and the factor other is a placeholder for an unknown cause.
notes: Both rounds rest on single databases. The $120K pre seed rests on an Employbl aggregator page. The $11M Series A of May 2021 rests on sp-edge; CB Insights reportedly lists a Series A in May 2020 and a Series B in June 2021, and another source says total funding of about $20M, so rounds are probably missing. The acquisition rests on a database (Seedtable) with the acquirer named as Superlatus. The YC page lists no website. The JUST Egg source is dated May 2019, about nine months after the Summer 2018 batch. YC lists Inactive while the database reports an acquisition, so exit is recorded as acquisition and the conflict is noted here. Competitor search for 2018 dated sources on plant cream cheese returned only undated reviews.
